### OpenRegister reliance

**heavy**: this component cannot work without OpenRegister. 2 direct references, 116 files reached through imports.

Through: `CnAnalyticsReportPicker`, `CnAuditTrailCard`, `CnBookmarkPicker`, `CnCalendarEventCreate`, `CnCalendarEventPicker`, `CnCellRenderer`, `CnChildRecordsField`, `CnCollectivePageCreate`, `CnCollectivePagePicker`, `CnContactPicker`, `CnCospendCreate`, `CnCospendPicker`, `CnDataTable`, `CnDeckCardCreate`, `CnDeckCardPicker`, `CnEmailPicker`, `CnFilesBrowser`, `CnFilesCard`, `CnFkResolveCell`, `CnFlowOperationPicker`, `CnFormDialog`, `CnIndexPage`, `CnMapPoiPicker`, `CnNoteComposer`, `CnNotesCard`, `CnObjectSidebar`, `CnOpenProjectCreate`, `CnOpenProjectPicker`, `CnPhotoAlbumPicker`, `CnPollPicker`, `CnResourceSelect`, `CnTagsCard`, `CnTalkRoomPicker`, `CnTaskFormDialog`, `CnTasksCard`, `CnTimeTrackerCreate`, `CnTimeTrackerPicker`, `CnVersionHistory`, `CnXwikiPageCreate`, `CnXwikiPagePicker`.

| `content`   | `union`                               |          | `\{\}`  | The widget's persisted configuration blob. - `scope` — whose relationship to list: `assigned` (default), `pooled`, `watched` or `all`. Whose INBOX it is stays the endpoint's decision; scope never names another user. - `limit` — rows to request AND show (1–50, default 6). The count line always states the server total regardless of this cap. - `pollSeconds` — refetch interval (default 30; `0` disables). - `rowRoute` — vue-router route NAME to open on a row click, receiving the task uuid as `:id`. Omitted = the click opens the task's openregister deep link instead. - `emptyText` — override for the empty-inbox line. - `variant` — `list` draws a checkbox list: a checkbox that completes the viewer's own task, the title, the subject on a second muted line and the due date at its right. Default: the compact rows. - `viewAllRoute` / `viewAllLabel` — a "View all" text link in the card header: a route name or location `{ name, params?, query? }`, and its label (default "View all"). `headerLink` works too. - `objectUuid` — the tasks on one record (`"@objectId"` reads the page's record), every assignee's, instead of the viewer's inbox. - `includeDone` — also list finished tasks (after the open ones). - `variant: 'table'` — the record's task table (board DqZaakTaken): task, handler, deadline, status and the row's verbs, with the summary ("1 open, 3 done · sorted by deadline") and a "New task" action in the card header. - `create` — offer "New task": `true`, or `{ appId?, label? }`; the task is posted as an open task on `objectUuid`. - `completeAny` — offer Complete on every open row, not only the viewer's own (the server still decides); `cancel` — offer Cancel. - `variant: 'focus'` — the first open task to work on in place: its number, handler, deadline, lock, who it is offered to, its form inline and its verbs, with the other open tasks listed under it. - `expandRows` — in the table, a row's title opens that task to work on in place under the table instead of following `rowRoute`; the opened task's title links to `rowRoute`. - `completeUrl` — the route Complete posts to instead of the engine's own (`{id}` is the task uuid), for an app that checks something of its own before the engine completes the task. - `claimCapabilityUrl` — a URL answering `{ claim: true\|false }`; Claim is offered only when it answers true. Without it Claim is offered on every pooled task. A task that carries a form is completed through CnTaskFormDialog, or with its form inline in the focus and opened-row cards. |
